SELECTED_INDEX: 8
CONFIDENCE: 0.64
EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows a strong carbonyl region with two bands at 1821 and 1759 cm⁻¹ consistent with a highly electron-withdrawing environment raising ν(C=O) (e.g., α-halogenated ketones often shift toward ~1760 cm⁻¹; the higher band can be a combination/Fermi feature). Multiple strong low-frequency bands at 531, 564, 654, and 673 cm⁻¹ indicate heavy-halogen stretches consistent with C–Br and C–Cl, while a band at 1015 cm⁻¹ fits a C–F stretch. Aliphatic C–H stretches at 2946–3031 cm⁻¹ and CH bending around 1374–1436 cm⁻¹ (GFQ-003) align with an aliphatic carbonyl compound. Among candidates, only 8 (CC(=O)[C@](F)(Cl)Br) contains F, Cl, Br and a carbonyl, matching the combined halogen- and carbonyl-related Raman features.
